description: This Java class provides utility methods to convert generic ChargeData objects into specific charge data objects for savings accounts and share accounts within the Fineract project.

classes.name: ConvertChargeDataToSpecificChargeData
classes.description: Utility class with static methods to convert ChargeData into specific charge data types for savings and share accounts.

methods.name: toSavingsAccountChargeData
methods.description: Converts a ChargeData object into a SavingsAccountChargeData object with defaulted null or zero values for certain fields.

methods.name: toShareAccountChargeData
methods.description: Converts a ChargeData object into a ShareAccountChargeData object with defaulted null or zero values for certain fields.
